comparison.objective: Re-space two gondola wire dividers to prescribed planogram holes without disturbing stocked boxes.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift and align each long divider so its rear foot enters a small hole while its front hook captures a fence wire.
comparison.success_condition: Both feet and hooks occupy the target pitches, products remain upright, and grippers clear the shelf.
comparison.reason: This is simultaneous two-end alignment and seating of shelf accessories, not tool-mediated angular adjustment and locknut retention.
